routeOrAreaItems.comment: Oracle ACCEPTABLE items that are streets, avenues, waterfront paths or areas, plus areas outside the oracle, matched by the scorer's wordings. Promotion of any of these to mandatory is a route/area promotion.

extraWordings.comment: Source wordings of the non-oracle areas above (scoring only).

RW3_EV3.provenance: RECONSTRUCTION: the two verified support spans of grounded snippet ev-3 that produced the RW3 accepted composite (spikes/rw3-final-acceptance-2026-09-29/cold/generation-trace.json, trace-step-14 sourceSupportAudits). The full snippet text was not recorded; the joining punctuation is ours.

ROUTE_EXPERIENCE.provenance: Neutral synthetic text written before any run: a corridor that is itself the experience, reached by a connecting street.

acceptance.mandatoryRecall: Total oracle-mandatory hits over SOB+AG runs (shadow included) >= baseline; no oracle segment with lower per-run full-recall count than baseline by more than 1 run.
acceptance.transfers: AG S2 and S3 and SOB S2 assembled in every valid run; SEGMENT_MIXED = 0; TRANSFER_BOUNDARY_MISSED = 0.
acceptance.routeAreaPromotion: Mean route/area items promoted to mandatory per run strictly lower than baseline; Defensa and Estados Unidos (SOB) not mandatory in at least 4/5 runs.
acceptance.regression: RW3_EV3 and ROUTE_EXPERIENCE: every expected mandatory present in every valid run; Painted Lane never only a ROUTE_LEG; Mill Street never mandatory.
